summary.zh: 把敌人送到不该站的位置，有时比直接扣血更有效。
summary.en: Moving an enemy somewhere dangerous can matter more than damage.

rules.zh: 攻击除了伤害，还会把目标沿方向推走或拉近。新位置会改变攻击目标、障碍关系和危险地形的作用。玩家先预估落点，再选择施力方向；位移后的局面成为下一步行动的起点。
rules.en: An attack can push or pull a target as well as deal damage. Its new position changes targeting, obstacles and hazards. Predict the landing point, choose a direction, then plan from the altered board.

decisions.zh: 直接打伤害，还是用位移让敌人的攻击落空？
decisions.en: Deal direct damage or displace the enemy so its attack misses?

decisions.zh: 把敌人推出战场，是否也会失去可回收的战利品？
decisions.en: Will pushing an enemy out of reach also lose recoverable loot?

effect.zh: 距离改变可达落点；过长会让站位准备失去意义。
effect.en: Distance changes reachable positions; excessive range weakens positioning.

effect.zh: 撞墙、撞人和落坑的结果必须分别清楚，玩家才能预判。
effect.en: Wall, unit and pit collisions need distinct, readable outcomes.

contrast.zh: 《陷阵之志》多用确定的格子位移解局；《博德之门3》还需要权衡成功判定、地形高度和战利品损失。
contrast.en: Into the Breach emphasizes deterministic grid displacement; Baldur’s Gate 3 adds success checks, elevation and possible loot loss.

combination.zh: 让推拉同时改变光束机关：敌人挡住光路，也能被推到开关上。
combination.en: Let displacement also alter a beam puzzle: enemies block beams or land on switches.

setup.zh: 怪物血量很高，身后一格是深坑，你站在它侧面。
setup.en: A tough monster stands one tile from a pit, while you are beside it.

action.zh: 先绕到它正前方，再用只造成1点伤害的推击。
action.en: Move in front of it, then use a push dealing only 1 damage.

result.zh: 怪物被推入坑中，低伤害动作解决了高血量目标。
result.en: The push drops it into the pit, solving a high-health threat with little damage.

next.zh: 下一只怪物背后是墙，你要重新寻找可利用的方向。
next.en: The next monster stands against a wall, requiring a different direction.

firstStep.zh: 只做四方向推一格、墙和坑；先不用真实物理模拟。
firstStep.en: Start with one-tile cardinal pushes, walls and pits, without full physics.

pitfall.zh: 落点不可见或碰撞结算顺序含糊，会让空间决策变成试错。
pitfall.en: Hidden landing positions or ambiguous collision order turn planning into guessing.

test.zh: 给出同一敌人的三种站位，看试玩者能否提出不同解法。
test.en: Give testers three positions for the same enemy and look for different solutions.
